title: Hood Wallet — Neon Crypto Wallet UI

versions.prompt: Mobile crypto wallet app "Hood Wallet" — three phone screens side by side on one canvas: balance home, send token, activity history. Visual theme (follow strictly): near-black background (#050b09), neon green #39ff14 and electric blue #5bd1ff as the ONLY accent colors, subtle pixel-grid / scanline texture, glowing edges and soft neon bloom, bold grotesk headings with monospace details, futuristic cyber-crypto aesthetic. Desktop 1440px wide, fill the first screen with the hero.
versions.html:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Hood Wallet — Neon Crypto Wallet UI</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#05050b;
  --bg-2:#070811;
  --green:#14d6ff;
  --blue:#c05bff;
  --ink:#d9e1f5;
  --muted:#6f768d;
  --line:rgba(20,214,255,.16);
  --line-b:rgba(192,91,255,.18);
  --phone-w:322px;
  --radius:40px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Space Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body{overflow-x:hidden;position:relative;min-height:100vh}

/* ---------- global textures ---------- */
.grid-bg,.bloom,.scan{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.grid-bg{
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(rgba(20,214,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,214,255,.055) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(rgba(192,91,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(192,91,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:128px 128px,128px 128px,32px 32px,32px 32px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(ellipse 100% 75% at 50% 35%,#000000 20%,transparent 85%);
}
.bloom{
  background:
    radial-gradient(520px 420px at 14% 18%,rgba(20,214,255,.16),transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(620px 480px at 86% 26%,rgba(192,91,255,.13),transparent 72%),
    radial-gradient(900px 500px at 50% 105%,rgba(20,214,255,.10),transparent 70%);
  filter:blur(6px);
}
.scan{
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.34) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px);
  opacity:.5;mix-blend-mode:multiply;z-index:60
}
.noise{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:59;pointer-events:none;opacity:.05;
  background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='120' height='120'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.9' numOctaves='2'/></filter><rect width='120' height='120' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='.6'/></svg>")}

.wrap{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:1440px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 40px}
.mono{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,monospace}

/* ---------- nav ---------- */
header.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;padding:22px 0 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.mark{width:34px;height:34px;flex:none;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px rgba(20,214,255,.6))}
.brand b{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
.brand span{display:block;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.34em;color:var(--muted)}
nav.links{display:flex;gap:30px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
nav.links a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;position:relative;padding-bottom:4px;transition:color .2s}
nav.links a:hover{color:var(--green)}
nav.links a::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:1px;background:var(--green);transition:width .25s;box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--green)}
nav.links a:hover::after{width:100%}
.nav-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.pill{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;padding:9px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;color:var(--muted)}
.pill .dot{display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--green);margin-right:8px;animation:blip 1.8s infinite}
@keyframes blip{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.25}}
.btn-neon{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#040712;background:var(--green);padding:12px 20px;border:0;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(20,214,255,.5),0 0 24px rgba(20,214,255,.45);transition:transform .18s,box-shadow .18s}
.btn-neon:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(20,214,255,.7),0 0 34px rgba(20,214,255,.7)}

/* ---------- hero ---------- */
.hero{min-height:calc(100vh - 78px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:34px 0 40px;gap:30px}
.hero-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:48px;align-items:end}
.kicker{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.42em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.kicker::before{content:"";width:46px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue),transparent);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--blue)}
h1{font-size:clamp(40px,5.6vw,78px);line-height:.92;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#eaf0ff}
h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--green);text-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(20,214,255,.55)}
h1 .blue{color:var(--blue);text-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(192,91,255,.5)}
.sub{margin-top:20px;max-width:430px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.65;color:#9da6bf}
.specs{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding-bottom:6px}
.spec{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;align-items:baseline;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(20,214,255,.18);padding-bottom:10px;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--muted)}
.spec b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.spec b.g{color:var(--green)}
.spec b.b{color:var(--blue)}

/* ---------- ticker ---------- */
.ticker{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);overflow:hidden;background:rgba(6,7,16,.7)}
.ticker-track{display:flex;gap:44px;padding:11px 0;width:max-content;animation:slide 32s linear infinite;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.ticker-track span b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.up{color:var(--green)}.down{color:var(--blue)}
@keyframes slide{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ---------- phones ---------- */
.stage{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-start;gap:46px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.unit{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.tag{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.tag i{font-style:normal;color:var(--green)}
.phone{
  position:relative;width:var(--phone-w);height:660px;border-radius:var(--radius);
  background:linear-gradient(170deg,#0b0c1a,#05050b 40%);
  border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.3);
  padding:11px;flex:none;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 44px rgba(20,214,255,.14),0 40px 80px -30px #000000, inset 0 0 40px rgba(20,214,255,.05);
  transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow .5s
}
.unit:nth-child(2) .phone{border-color:rgba(192,91,255,.34);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 50px rgba(192,91,255,.16),0 40px 80px -30px #000000,inset 0 0 40px rgba(192,91,255,.05)}
.phone:hover{transform:translateY(-10px)}
.screen{position:relative;height:100%;border-radius:30px;overflow:hidden;background:#05050b;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(20,214,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(20,214,255,.04) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:24px 24px}
.screen::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,.22) 0 1px,transparent 1px 3px);opacity:.55}
.notch{position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:98px;height:20px;border-radius:12px;background:#020306;border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.15);z-index:5}
.status{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:13px 20px 2px;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);position:relative;z-index:6}
.bars{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:flex-end}
.bars i{display:block;width:3px;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 6px rgba(20,214,255,.8)}
.bars i:nth-child(1){height:4px}.bars i:nth-child(2){height:6px}.bars i:nth-child(3){height:8px}.bars i:nth-child(4){height:10px}
.batt{width:20px;height:9px;border:1px solid var(--muted);border-radius:2px;position:relative;display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle}
.batt::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:1.5px;right:5px;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 6px var(--green)}
.body{flex:1;overflow:hidden;padding:14px 18px 0;position:relative;z-index:3;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

/* screen bits */
.srow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.35);display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--green);background:rgba(20,214,255,.07);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(20,214,255,.18) inset}
.addr{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em}
.addr b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:500}
.iconbtn{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--muted);background:rgba(255,255,255,.015)}

.balcard{margin-top:18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:18px 16px 16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;
  background:radial-gradient(120% 100% at 0% 0%,rgba(20,214,255,.10),transparent 60%),rgba(6,7,16,.6)}
.balcard::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:-40%;width:40%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,rgba(20,214,255,.10),transparent);animation:sweep 5.5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sweep{0%{left:-45%}55%,100%{left:120%}}
.lab{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.big{font-size:38px;line-height:1;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin-top:9px;color:#f2f7ff;text-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(20,214,255,.35)}
.big small{font-size:19px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500}
.delta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:11px;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--green);background:rgba(20,214,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.25);padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px}
.spark{position:absolute;right:-4px;bottom:0;width:150px;opacity:.85}

.actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.act{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:11px 4px 9px;text-align:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.015);transition:.2s}
.act:hover{border-color:rgba(20,214,255,.5);background:rgba(20,214,255,.07)}
.act svg{display:block;margin:0 auto 6px}
.act span{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.act.primary{background:rgba(20,214,255,.12);border-color:rgba(20,214,255,.45);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(20,214,255,.18)}
.act.primary span{color:var(--green)}

.sechead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:18px 0 8px}
.sechead h3{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bfc9e6}
.sechead a{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--blue);text-decoration:none}
.tokens{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;overflow:hidden}
.token{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.1);border-radius:14px;background:rgba(8,10,18,.55);transition:.2s}
.token:hover{border-color:rgba(192,91,255,.35);transform:translateX(2px)}
.coin{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700}
.c-g{background:rgba(20,214,255,.12);color:var(--green);border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.3)}
.c-b{background:rgba(192,91,255,.12);color:var(--blue);border:1px solid rgba(192,91,255,.3)}
.t-name{flex:1;min-width:0}
.t-name b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;color:#e6edff}
.t-name span{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:9.5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.08em}
.t-val{text-align:right}
.t-val b{display:block;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#e6edff}
.t-val span{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:9.5px}

/* send screen */
.topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:4px}
.topbar h2{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#d8e1fb}
.field{margin-top:14px;border:1px solid var(--line-b);border-radius:16px;padding:12px 14px;background:rgba(15,6,20,.5)}
.field.focus{border-color:rgba(192,91,255,.55);box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(192,91,255,.16)}
.field .lab{margin-bottom:7px}
.field .val{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:12.5px;color:#e6edff;letter-spacing:.04em;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.verified{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--green);border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.3);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 8px;flex:none}
.amount{margin-top:14px;text-align:center;padding:16px 10px 14px;border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.2);border-radius:18px;background:radial-gradient(100% 120% at 50% 0%,rgba(20,214,255,.09),transparent 65%)}
.amount .num{font-size:44px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:#f2f7ff;text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(20,214,255,.4);line-height:1}
.amount .num i{font-style:normal;color:var(--green);animation:caret 1.1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes caret{50%{opacity:0}}
.amount .fiat{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:6px;justify-content:center;margin-top:11px}
.chip{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.14em;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted)}
.chip.on{color:var(--green);border-color:rgba(20,214,255,.45);background:rgba(20,214,255,.1)}
.pad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:6px;margin-top:13px}
.key{border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.1);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 0;text-align:center;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:16px;color:#dfe6f7;background:rgba(255,255,255,.012);transition:.15s;cursor:pointer}
.key:hover{background:rgba(20,214,255,.1);color:var(--green);border-color:rgba(20,214,255,.4)}
.fee{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:12px;letter-spacing:.08em}
.fee b{color:var(--blue);font-weight:500}
.slide{margin-top:auto;margin-bottom:16px;position:relative;height:52px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.35);background:rgba(20,214,255,.07);display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(20,214,255,.2)}
.slide span{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green)}
.knob{width:44px;height:44px;margin-left:4px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);display:grid;place-items:center;z-index:2;box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(20,214,255,.7);animation:nudge 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes nudge{0%,70%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}85%{transform:translateX(10px)}}

/* activity */
.filters{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.day{font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:16px 0 8px}
.tx{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.08)}
.txi{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:10px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.22);background:rgba(20,214,255,.07)}
.txi.b{border-color:rgba(192,91,255,.25);background:rgba(192,91,255,.08)}
.tx .t-name b{font-size:12.5px}
.searchbar{margin-top:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:9px 12px;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);background:rgba(255,255,255,.015)}

.tabbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;padding:12px 18px 18px;border-top:1px solid rgba(20,214,255,.12);position:relative;z-index:4;background:rgba(4,4,10,.7)}
.tab{display:grid;place-items:center;gap:5px;color:#394554}
.tab.on{color:var(--green);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px rgba(20,214,255,.7))}
.tab i{font-style:normal;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}

/* footer strip */
.strip{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:8px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--line)}
.cell{background:var(--bg);padding:22px 18px}
.cell h4{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--green);margin-bottom:8px}
.cell p{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:#8f95b2}
footer.end{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;padding:18px 0 28px;font-family:"JetBrains Mono",monospace;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#4c546a;text-transform:uppercase}

@media(max-width:1380px){.stage{gap:30px}.phone{transform:scale(.94)}.unit{margin:0 -8px}}
@media(max-width:1160px){
  .hero-top{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .stage{gap:26px}
  .phone{transform:scale(.88)}
  .unit{margin:0 -18px}
}
@media(max-width:980px){
  nav.links,.nav-cta .pill{display:none}
  .hero{min-height:auto}
  .phone{transform:none}
  .unit{margin:0}
  .strip{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .wrap{padding:0 20px}
  .hero{padding:26px 0}
  .stage{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:40px}
  .strip{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:400px){
  :root{--phone-w:300px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<!--tr-cover-->
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@400;700;800;900&family=Inter:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
.trc{--a:#4fe6ff;position:relative;z-index:1000;height:100vh;min-height:620px;overflow:hidden;background:#000;color:#fff;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;isolation:isolate}
.trc-s{position:absolute;inset:-4%;background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.4s ease;animation:trcKen 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.trc-s.on{opacity:1}
@keyframes trcKen{from{transform:scale(1) translate3d(0,0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.09) translate3d(-1.5%,-1%,0)}}
.trc::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.55) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 22%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 48%,rgba(0,0,0,.82) 100%)}
.trc-nav{position:absolute;z-index:3;top:18px;left:24px;right:24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;padding:10px 12px 10px 16px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(10,10,12,.42);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
.trc-logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:-.01em;white-space:nowrap}
.trc-logo i{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;background:var(--a);box-shadow:0 0 22px var(--a);display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;color:#000;font-size:13px;font-weight:900}
.trc-links{display:flex;gap:22px;flex:1}
.trc-links a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);text-decoration:none;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500}
.trc-links a:hover{color:#fff}
.trc-btn{height:38px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:#fff;font:600 13px Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}

<script>
// subtle parallax bloom follow
const bloom = document.querySelector('.bloom');
window.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  const x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - .5) * 18;
  const y = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - .5) * 14;
  bloom.style.transform = `translate(${x}px, ${y}px)`;
}, {passive:true});

// keypad flicker feedback
document.querySelectorAll('.key').forEach(k => {
  k.addEventListener('click', () => {
    k.animate([{filter:'brightness(2.4)'},{filter:'brightness(1)'}], {duration:280, easing:'ease-out'});
  });
});
